name: lukka-analytics
description: Implied rates, volatility surfaces and OTC FX observations. Requires a Lukka account.

interface.longDescription: Lukka Quantitative Analytics MCP. Research digital asset implied rate term structures, options implied volatility surfaces and OTC FX observations from Lukka Analytics. Compare supported Monte Carlo and Nelson-Siegel-Svensson rate models, delta or strike grids, and available output shapes. Requires a connected Lukka account with Analytics entitlement and coverage for the selected entity and asset. Outputs describe observed analytics and do not execute orders or guarantee investment outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Show a small sample of available OTC FX observations.
Show available Bitcoin USD implied rates.
Show a Bitcoin delta volatility surface.

prompts: Show a small sample of available OTC FX observations from Lukka Analytics.
Show Bitcoin USD implied rates using the Monte Carlo model for an entity available to my account.
Show the same Bitcoin USD rate query using the NSS model so I can compare the returned observations.
Show a small Bitcoin options volatility surface using delta moneyness for an available entity.
Show a small Bitcoin options volatility surface using strike moneyness for the same entity.

positive.prompt: Show a small sample of available OTC FX observations from Lukka Analytics.
positive.expected_behavior: Request a bounded flat response, limit 5. Report only returned pairs, entities, tenors and observation times; do not invent unavailable rows.

positive.prompt: Show Bitcoin USD implied rates using the Monte Carlo model for an entity available to my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Use pairCode XBT-USD, modelType MC, an entitled entity, and documented curveType/source/rateType values. Bound output to 5 rows and state coverage or entitlement failures.

positive.description: Rate model variation with matched inputs.
positive.prompt: Show the same Bitcoin USD rate query using the NSS model so I can compare the returned observations.
positive.expected_behavior: Use modelType NSS with the same entity, pair, curve, source, rate type and UTC window as the preceding MC case. Distinguish empty model coverage from zero rates.

positive.prompt: Show a small Bitcoin options volatility surface using delta moneyness for an available entity.
positive.expected_behavior: Use underlyingAssetLukkaCode XBT, moneyness delta, an entitled entity and limit 5. Report returned tenor/grid labels and volatility units.

positive.prompt: Show a small Bitcoin options volatility surface using strike moneyness for the same entity.
positive.expected_behavior: Use moneyness strike with the same entitled entity and time window as the delta case. Preserve actual grid labels rather than relabeling strikes as deltas.

negative.description: Explain that the connector provides analytics and cannot place orders; do not claim execution.
negative.prompt: Place an options order on the exchange using this volatility surface.

negative.description: Explain that analytics do not guarantee future outcomes and do not fabricate a risk-free trade.
negative.prompt: Guarantee which derivatives trade will make a profit next week.

negative.description: Explain that account position access and portfolio execution are not provided by this server; do not claim a rebalance occurred.
negative.prompt: Open my exchange positions and rebalance them automatically.

publication.release_notes: Removes MCP from public product names to follow OpenAI naming guidelines. Retains the product-specific skills, Lukka website and existing MCP configuration.
